subject: Marketplace invoice reconciliation & usage evidence handoff
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: billing@acmecloud.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Marketplace invoice reconciliation & usage evidence handoff

Hi Liam / Acme billing team,

Following up on invoice INV-ACME-202705 (dated 2027-05-31) — our ledger shows a ~EUR 18.4k delta versus the marketplace payout. We pulled the canonical usage exports from the three impacted projects and a consolidated reconciliation sheet. I attached the primary exports and uploaded a readme to the Drive folder (link below).

Request: can you confirm receipt and tell us which dataset you want for your audit (raw usage CSV vs. normalized marketplace lines)? We'd like to get an agreed evidence bundle to close the payout variance and the VAT pass-through ticket.

Quick summary of what we attached:
- gcp_usage_export_202705.csv — raw GCP consumption (per-hour, per-resource) from our billing export
- aws_marketplace_report_may2027.xlsx — normalized marketplace lines with seller-entity mapping we applied
- metering-evidence-readme.txt — notes on timestamps (UTC vs. CET) and the applied proration rules

Internal notes: Monica and Jonas — please confirm the entity mapping in the AWS sheet is final before I send this to their finance ops team.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XyQEvidenceBundle
HubSpot: HS-94872

Thanks,
--
Priyom Das
Account Lead, Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference
pri...@redwoodinference.com
+44 20 7946 01 23
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmecloud.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: billing@acmecloud.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 13:47:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Marketplace invoice reconciliation & usage evidence handoff

Priyom, thanks for the quick turnaround and the bundle. We received the Drive folder and the three files. High level: the marketplace platform has two places where charges are generated (aggregated "listing" lines and the underlying hourly-metered export) — we need the normalized lines + mapping back to your hourly export for audit.

Action items from Acme:
- We will ingest the AWS normalized sheet and run a reconciliation against our marketplace ledger by EOD Thu (2027-06-03).
- For GCP, please confirm the timezone handling — we saw CET timestamps in your readme but the marketplace ingestion expects UTC.

Can you confirm that the GCP CSV has timestamps in UTC and that the proration rules in the readme were applied only to partial-day resources? If so, send a one-line confirmation and we'll proceed with the ingestion.

Regards,
Liam
Billing Operations — Marketplace
Acme Cloud
liam.oconnor@acmecloud.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmecloud.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Marketplace invoice reconciliation & usage evidence handoff

On Tue, 1 Jun 2027 at 13:47 +0100, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmecloud.com> wrote:
> Priyom, thanks for the quick turnaround and the bundle. We received the Drive folder and the three files. High level: the marketplace platform has two places where charges are generated (aggregated "listing" lines and the underlying hourly-metered export) — we need the normalized lines + mapping back to your hourly export for audit.
> 
> Action items from Acme:
> - We will ingest the AWS normalized sheet and run a reconciliation against our marketplace ledger by EOD Thu (2027-06-03).
> - For GCP, please confirm the timezone handling — we saw CET timestamps in your readme but the marketplace ingestion expects UTC.

Hi Liam — confirmed: the GCP CSV timestamps are in UTC. The readme included a CET example because our regional finance team expressed the timestamps in CET for their internal reporting. The metering-evidence-readme.txt makes this explicit (line 12). Proration: we only applied proration to snapshot/short-lived ephemeral resources that started/ended mid-day; full-day instances are unadjusted.

Monica: entity mapping on the AWS sheet is final per our finance team — Marissa, please confirm if you want to add any supplemental mapping notes for Acme ingestion.

If that looks good, Liam, we'll also export a tiny sample (first 7 days of May) in parquet and drop it in the Drive folder so you can smoke-test your ingestion pipeline without processing the full month.

Best,
Priyom
--
Priyom Das
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 11:34:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Marketplace invoice reconciliation & usage evidence handoff

Thanks — quick internal confirmation: AWS mapping is final (we reconciled seller-tax-ids against the contract table). I added one note to the Drive readme about how we normalized per-seller discounts (folder: docs/discount-normalization.md).

I'll generate the 7-day sample parquet and upload it by 15:00 CET today. Also flagging finance that the VAT treatment for the May settlement will need the final mapping for the EU entity — Jonas, can you drop the legal entity code in HubSpot once you confirm?

Marissa
Billing Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmecloud.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: billing@acmecloud.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 15:07:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Marketplace invoice reconciliation & usage evidence handoff

Priyom / team — we ingested the AWS sheet and the GCP sample (thanks for the quick sample upload). Results: the ingestion flagged the same 3 listing lines where marketplace aggregation and hourly-metered attribution diverge.

Next steps:
1) We'll provision a temporary dispute ticket (DT-3441) and push our reconciliation diff + traceability file to the Drive folder by EOD Fri (2027-06-04).
2) If your finance/legal confirm the mapping, we can close the payout variance and process the VAT-adjusted payout the following settlement window.

Thanks again for the thorough evidence pack — the transparency speeds this up.

Regards,
Liam
